messages:
rohan: Quick heads-up — planning a rolling kernel + quant-profile rollout tonight in the 22:00–23:30 UTC maintenance slot. Target models: llama-2-13b-q4 and redwood-v1-ctr. I'll be the primary deployer.

maria: Ack. Which nodes are in the initial wave?

rohan: Wave A: us-west-2:gpu-pool-3 (12 nodes). Wave B: us-east-1:gpu-pool-2. We'll start with 3 nodes in A for a smoke stage, then expand to 6 before moving to B.

devon: I'll own smoke verification. Plan: 15m canary on 3 nodes with perf + accuracy spot checks, then expand to full pool if green. CI will run the automated smoke too.

ci-bot: [automated] smoke pipeline queued: smoke/quant+kernel/quick-stats (run id: s-2026-1759).

rohan: Manual smoke command (ssh into a canary node):
```
ssh deploy@gpu-01 -- sudo /opt/redwood/bin/smoke-check --model llama-2-13b-q4 --samples 50 --metrics latency,p99,token-cost
```

maria: If smoke passes, what's the rollback path? Do we revert kernel package or switch model variant? Need precise steps for oncall.

rohan: Rollback plan (short): 1) Run ansible rollback playbook to restore kernel package -> `ansible-playbooks/rollback-kernel.yml` 2) Switch routing to fallback model variant `redwood-v1-ctr-fallback` via routing API 3) Re-enable old quant profile if needed. Full steps are in ops-runbooks/rollbacks (link: https://confluence/redwood/ops/runbooks/rollbacks).

devon: Request: please disable autoscaler temporarily for the affected pools during waves A/B to avoid churn noise in perf numbers.

sre-oncall: I can disable autoscale for the window. Post a clear "go" message here when you're ready and I will lock it down and add a quick monitor on cluster CPU/GPU utilization.

maria: Code review ping — PR #4126 (quant profile tweaks) is LGTM'd but needs the quant_seed param set to barlow-7 to match prior experiments.

rohan: Thanks — pushed the small fix to PR #4126 and merged. Checklist before start: PR merged, canary nodes reserved, smoke owner (devon), SRE standby (sre-oncall), rollback playbook sanity-checked. Start time targeted 22:05 UTC, go/no-go at 21:45 UTC. :thumbsup:

devon: I'll be on-call and reachable by phone. Will post smoke results to this thread and drop quick perf/accuracy snapshots. :phone:

sre-oncall: Standing by and will post when autoscaler is disabled. :eyes:

rohan: GO at 21:46 UTC — node reservation in progress, kicking off pre-deploy checks now. Will update when the first canary is up.
